newsitem.title: USA: Diana Corp says restructuring on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Diana Corp says restructuring on schedule.

text.p: Diana Corp on Thursday responded to unusually heavy activity in its stock and market rumors by saying its planned restructuring is on schedule.
It said that the establishment of Sattel Communications as a separate entity, the spin-off of other operating units and other efforts to improve shareholder value remain a priority.

Diana said Sattel revenues in the last 1996 quarter were $4.3 million-$4.4 million, against nil a year earlier and $4.0 million in the third quarter 1996. Gross margins were similar in third and fourth 1996 quarters, it said.

Diana shares, which have fluctuated wildly between 114 and 11-3/4 in the last 12 months, were in early Thursday trade 1 higher at 17-1/2. The company did not detail the rumors it said affected the stock.

It said that research and development spending at Sattel was on target at $750,000 in the quarter, an 85 percent increase from the third quarter. The fourth quarter loss at the unit will be $750,000 to $1 million against a "modest profit" in the previous quarter, it said.
Diana Corp repeated that its total net loss for the quarter is expected to be $1.5 million. It gave no further details. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1610))
